cohort: The study analyzed 214 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean delivery (CD) under neuraxial anesthesia (NA).
finding: A prenatal risk assessment model was developed which identified age at delivery >33 years, history of CD >1, preoperative HGB <100 g/L, placenta previa classification, vascular lacunae, and labor duration as significant risk factors for severe peripartum hemorrhage in PAS patients undergoing CD under NA, achieving an accuracy of 0.68 to 0.71.
